reviews.text: They are very helpful, patient and prepared. They helped us a lot with our dog and the training and daycare were very useful. I recommend them to everyone!
Best school, with the best instructors! I recommend it! 🤩 …

In the basic small dog course, Laci is a fantastic instructor, empathetic, and incredibly attentive. On the other hand, Saci, who is also an instructor in theory, is critically inferior to me. She sprays the dogs, yells at them, is aggressive with them, even if she knows that the dog comes from a traumatized background or is afraid of people. Saci can be seen to know what kind of dogs (breeds) she likes, and she behaves accordingly with the ones she doesn't like. There is not a single bit of kindness in her, she is unsuited for this task.
Very cool place, the instructors are professional and very nice. I recommend it to everyone ❤️

We were on a basic course, with my American Cocker Spaniel. I can only say good things, professional knowledge, helpfulness, I have been to other dog schools, trainers, and I got the most knowledge here!

Every time we go, my dog ​​feels great. He arrives happy and we leave pleasantly tired after all the playing :)
The instructors are very nice, the courts are clean and tidy, we still go here regularly to this day.

Extremely prepared, professional and helpful team, enjoyable lectures and varied exercises! I wholeheartedly recommend the puppy course to every little "puppy" who wants to grow into a lovable dog! :)
Thank you very much for the stars!

We completed a basic course with my teenage 10-month-old Labrador named Dormeó. I am very satisfied with the school, the instructors, but I would also like to highlight the helpers on the field. My dog ​​has developed a lot, he listens to me, listens to me, and can be called in. I can only recommend it to everyone! Their daycare is absolutely sensational! With professional supervision!
I leave my dog ​​there with a calm heart for a whole day of partying, and I return home with a happy, tired, obedient, and listens to me Labrador.

We attended basic dog training with Péter Vass and Adri, and besides having a great time, we received professional training and covered a lot of topics. What we learned here was extremely useful! Thank you very much!☺️ (Excellent exam😍) …

I think it's the best professional workshop, we studied there too. They are not static but characterized by modern renewal. Success requires two parts, one part is definitely in order, the other depends on you.
Studied under Gábor Zsömi.
Golden Life Zsömi youtube chanel
In the end, I didn't take my dog ​​here, but not because there was anything negative!

I am very satisfied with the dog school, the instructors are prepared and conscientiously deal with the dogs. The topics are well structured and help with development step by step. My only suggestion is that for rainy days it would be good to create some kind of covered solution for more comfortable practice.

Professional and kind.
The classes are well organized.
The location is perfect for the activity.
🎖️🐕🎓👍 …

Although it was a bit strange to get there at first, this was offset by the beautifully fenced area surrounded by huge trees that provided shade. I was also professionally satisfied with the team, and even as an old dog owner, I learned useful new things.
Both the place and the Mirror Method are magical! I am very happy that we could learn here "as a dog"!
Thank you very much for the stars!
Great activity for dogs with reasonable and reliable supervision

Super professional team! Our puppy Zserbó and we, his owners, learned a lot during the training. What I especially liked about the sessions was that in addition to learning, there was always time for playing, so every class was very enjoyable for Zserbó too. I can only recommend it! 🤗 …

I am extremely enthusiastic and satisfied. It is a very diverse training, it teaches you everything you need to get started. I felt the learning was the ideal balance of theory and play. The instructors and helpers are professionals and truly understand my dog's soul, better than I do. I adopted Luna 3 months ago and she has improved a lot during the training. Thank you and gratitude for everything, especially for the honest feedback. We will come to you again.

Apache has been going through a lot of development since we started coming here. The behavioral therapy has already done wonders, then we started the basic level, which has also given us an amazing amount. Professional, knowledgeable instructors, which is no wonder, because Népsziget Dog School is a Concept! 😊🙏🏻 …
The best school for training dogs
A school worth traveling 200km to if you want your dog to vibrate with you! Thank you!
Good place. I would be a farmer here, a trainer - if I knew how - or even a dog. I love being here. It fills me up, smooths me out, makes me smile.
Gábor Korom and his team of trainers have incredible expertise in dog behavior and training. If you are looking for a good dog school, look no further. :)
Best dog school, everyone is super professional!

I learned a lot from them about raising our dog. He feels great at the doggy daycare, then he sleeps until the next day. I love the videos that Zsu uploads to the fb group, so I can see their "pranks". 😉 …
They are kind, helpful and supportive throughout the entire education. Quality environment, well-equipped school, prepared teachers. I can only recommend them!
They are kind and professional. They helped a lot in treating our difficult dog, I recommend them to everyone who is thinking about dog school or daycare.
Great instructors! Very nice helpers, watchful. We learned a lot from them and our relationship with my dog ​​has improved a lot. Great location. I would happily leave my dog ​​at their daycare.

We did a puppy course with my American bulldog puppy. I am infinitely grateful that the Mirror Method "curriculum" gave us the opportunity to start training at 3 months old! The atmosphere, the experience, the knowledge gained are unsurpassed! I recommend it to everyone from the bottom of my heart!
Dear Instructors and Helpers! You deserve a 6-star rating!
We've been coming here for years, it's all love and fun!
Best place to escape with your dog :)
